bandeja.texto: Dinero a la cuenta ····4456, que no conozco: no es de ningún estado de cuenta ni tarjeta de la empresa, ni la diste de alta como tuya. No se supone personal. Si es de la empresa (la reserva recién abierta, una cuenta nueva, una tarjeta nueva, la línea de crédito, un préstamo, una cuenta de ahorro en otro banco), da de alta su número: sube su estado de cuenta (su número queda), o confírmalo antes con un lote vacío a su cuenta del plan desde el SQL Editor (select fn_banco_importar_filas('{"origen": "mano", "cuenta": "1030", "ultimos4": "4456", "confirmo_cuenta": true, "nombre": "su número ····4456", "filas": []}'); con la cuenta que sea: 1030 es la reserva, 2510 la línea de crédito, 2520 o 2530 un préstamo de vehículo); y vuelve a «Casar»: se propone como lo que es (dinero entre cuentas propias; de la línea de crédito o de un préstamo, su pago o su desembolso), sin motivo. Si es tu cuenta personal, dala de alta desde el SQL Editor (select fn_banco_cuenta_personal('4456', 'el nombre de la cuenta');) y se propone como lo que es (préstamo, aportación o distribución), sin motivo. Mientras tanto, cada opción pide su motivo escrito: nada va al patrimonio del accionista ni a otra cuenta propia sin decir por qué.

paquete.title: Accounting Package — 2026 (partial year: 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31)

entity.note: De fábrica: Form 1120 (C-corp), lo que dice la carta CP 575 de la corporación. Pendiente de confirmar con el CPA si se presentó el Form 2553 (S-corp).

warnings: PARTIAL YEAR: the books in this system start on 2026-10-01 (opening balances as of 2026-09-30, carried over from the prior accounting system). The income statement and the tax-line amounts cover 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31 only; activity from 2026-01-01 to 2026-09-30 is in the prior system (QuickBooks) and is NOT included here.

ENTITY TYPE PENDING CONFIRMATION: this package uses Form 1120 (C corporation). The corporation's IRS notice CP 575 assigns Form 1120 (C corporation); an S election (Form 2553) has not been confirmed for this entity. Please confirm which form applies before relying on the tax-line summary; the line mapping for the other form is available on request.
The fiscal year is not closed in the books yet: figures may still change.
Line numbers follow the 2025 forms; verify against the forms for tax year 2026. Book figures only: no tax adjustments (Schedule M-1), tax depreciation or tax computation are included.

tax_lines.label: Line 2 — Cost of goods sold (attach Form 1125-A)
Schedule L, line 2a — Trade notes and accounts receivable

tax_lines.note: Per the balance sheet: retained earnings account plus prior-year results, plus net income for the year, less shareholder distributions (the books do not post a year-end closing entry).
tax_lines.label: Schedule L, line 25 — Retained earnings—Unappropriated

balance_sheet.label: Assets less liabilities and equity (must be 0)

trial_balance.name: Subcontractors
trial_balance.note: Form 1099-NEC for each subcontractor paid $600 or more.

chart_of_accounts.name: Stripe — Payments in Transit
chart_of_accounts.note: Clearing account for online payments; clears to the bank within days.

chart_of_accounts.name: Due from Shareholder
chart_of_accounts.note: Shareholder loan receivable; review for constructive distribution.

chart_of_accounts.name: Stripe — Payouts in Transit
chart_of_accounts.note: Clearing account; payouts on their way to the bank.
chart_of_accounts.name_es: Stripe — depósitos en camino a Chase

chart_of_accounts.name: Allowance for Doubtful Accounts
chart_of_accounts.note: Book allowance; tax uses the specific charge-off method.

chart_of_accounts.name: Costs & Estimated Earnings in Excess of Billings
chart_of_accounts.note: Underbillings (WIP schedule).
chart_of_accounts.name_es: Costo y utilidad en exceso de facturación

chart_of_accounts.name: Materials Inventory
chart_of_accounts.note: Form 1125-A: ending inventory (line 7); prior year-end balance is line 1.

chart_of_accounts.name: Accumulated Depreciation
chart_of_accounts.note: Book depreciation; tax depreciation per Form 4562.

chart_of_accounts.name: Accrued Expenses
chart_of_accounts.name_es: Costos y gastos devengados por pagar

chart_of_accounts.name: Use Tax Payable
chart_of_accounts.note: Florida use tax (Form DR-15).

chart_of_accounts.name: Billings in Excess of Costs & Estimated Earnings
chart_of_accounts.note: Overbillings (WIP schedule).

chart_of_accounts.name: Provision for Contract Losses
chart_of_accounts.note: Book accrual; see account 5950.

chart_of_accounts.name: Shareholder Distributions
chart_of_accounts.note: Not an expense. C corporation: a dividend to the shareholder (Form 1099-DIV may apply). S corporation: Schedule K, line 16d and Schedule M-2, line 7. Includes personal charges paid by the company.

chart_of_accounts.name: Interest Income
chart_of_accounts.note: S corporation: portfolio income, reported on Schedule K (not on page 1).

chart_of_accounts.name: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Assets
chart_of_accounts.note: Form 4797.
chart_of_accounts.name_es: Ganancia o pérdida en venta de activos

chart_of_accounts.name: Direct Labor — Officer
chart_of_accounts.note: Officer compensation included in cost of labor: report on Form 1125-E and subtract what is claimed on Form 1125-A.

chart_of_accounts.name: Labor Burden
chart_of_accounts.note: Payroll taxes, workers' compensation and benefits on direct labor.

chart_of_accounts.name: Labor Burden Applied to Jobs
chart_of_accounts.note: Standard burden applied to jobs; nets against 5015 and 5019.

chart_of_accounts.name: Subcontractors
chart_of_accounts.note: Form 1099-NEC for each subcontractor paid $600 or more.

chart_of_accounts.name: Provision for Contract Losses
chart_of_accounts.note: Book accrual for expected losses; not deductible until realized (Schedule M-1 adjustment).

chart_of_accounts.name: Officer Compensation
chart_of_accounts.note: Form 1125-E. S corporation: reasonable compensation of the shareholder-employee.

chart_of_accounts.name: Shareholder Health Insurance (>2%)
chart_of_accounts.note: S corporation: include in the shareholder's W-2 wages (line 7). C corporation: employee benefit programs (line 24).

chart_of_accounts.name: Payroll Taxes & Burden — Admin
chart_of_accounts.note: Employer payroll taxes; any workers' compensation or benefits portion belongs in other deductions or employee benefits.

chart_of_accounts.name: Bank & Merchant Fees
chart_of_accounts.name_es: Cargos bancarios y comisiones de tarjeta

chart_of_accounts.name: Insurance
chart_of_accounts.note: General liability, auto and umbrella.

chart_of_accounts.name: Vehicle Expense
chart_of_accounts.note: Fuel, tolls, repairs and maintenance (actual expenses).

chart_of_accounts.name: Meals (50%)
chart_of_accounts.note: Booked at 100%; 50% deductible. Nondeductible half: Form 1120 Schedule M-1, line 5c / Form 1120-S Schedule K, line 16c.

chart_of_accounts.name: Professional Fees
chart_of_accounts.note: Accounting and legal.

chart_of_accounts.name: Depreciation
chart_of_accounts.note: Book depreciation; tax depreciation per Form 4562 (Section 179 / bonus are the CPA's election).

chart_of_accounts.name: Bad Debt
chart_of_accounts.note: Deductible when specifically charged off.

chart_of_accounts.name: Charitable Contributions
chart_of_accounts.note: C corporation: limited to 10% of taxable income. S corporation: passes through on Schedule K.

chart_of_accounts.name: Penalties & Fines
chart_of_accounts.note: Nondeductible.

chart_of_accounts.name: Taxes & Licenses
chart_of_accounts.note: Business taxes of the company (not the shareholder's income tax).
chart_of_accounts.name_es: Impuestos y tasas de la EMPRESA

warnings: PARTIAL YEAR: the books in this system start on 2026-10-01 (opening balances as of 2026-09-30, carried over from the prior accounting system). The income statement and the tax-line amounts cover 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31 only; activity from 2026-01-01 to 2026-09-30 is in the prior system (QuickBooks) and is NOT included here.

ENTITY TYPE PENDING CONFIRMATION: this package uses Form 1120-S (S corporation). The corporation's IRS notice CP 575 assigns Form 1120 (C corporation); an S election (Form 2553) has not been confirmed for this entity. Please confirm which form applies before relying on the tax-line summary; the line mapping for the other form is available on request.
The fiscal year is not closed in the books yet: figures may still change.
Line numbers follow the 2025 forms; verify against the forms for tax year 2026. Book figures only: no tax adjustments (Schedule M-1), tax depreciation or tax computation are included.
